classification.verdictNote: JONATHAN Y's own design, sold under its own name across many big retailers. The wood look is a printed finish on resin.
classification.summary: An original product from JONATHAN Y, a lighting and rug brand that sells through Target, Overstock, Kohl's, Walmart and others. No individual designer is credited. The stacked bobbin stem is a classic turned-wood form; here it is cast in resin and finished to look like light oak.

designer.note: None credited; JONATHAN Y's in-house team

quality: The look is a turned-wood bobbin stem under a tapered pleated paper shade, a popular mix of rustic and modern. The stem is resin with a printed wood grain, not wood, which keeps the price and weight down (10.56 lb) but won't age like real wood.

If you like this silhouette in real wood, the Adesso Orchard (sold as the Otto at Urban Outfitters) in your library is solid wood with a linen drum shade. Paper shades are more delicate than linen and harder to clean.

retailers.notes: Sale, regular $293.32. A third-party seller on Target's marketplace, not Target itself, so returns go through the seller. Doesn't ship to Alaska, Hawaii or US territories.

maker.name: JONATHAN Y
paragraphs: JONATHAN Y is a lighting, rug and accent furniture brand owned by JONATHAN Y Designs, Inc., which also owns the happimess label. It pitches "designer styling" at low prices and sells mostly through marketplaces: Target, Walmart, Overstock, Kohl's and others, often as the seller itself.
It doesn't credit individual designers. Many of its lamps reinterpret popular looks (bobbin, rattan, Tiffany-style, mid-century) in resin, iron and paper to hit the price.
